title: exudyn.HT without SetTranslation, RotateVector, RotateVectorTransposed, SetIdentity, Get and Invert, which the constructor, the properties and Inverse write as well
author: Claude-JG
description: Revision2026c step RG12.69.2. The six functions are written as H.translation = p or exu.HT(translation=p), H.rotation @ v, H.rotation.T @ v, exu.HT(), (H.rotation, H.translation) and H = H.Inverse(); the symbolic HT (#3174) has one way for each. Decided: removed without deprecation (exudyn.HT was released in 1.13.6 and is little used).
releaseNotes: exudyn.HT has one way for each operation: SetTranslation, RotateVector, RotateVectorTransposed, SetIdentity, Get and Invert are removed; write H.translation = p or exu.HT(translation=p), H.rotation @ v, H.rotation.T @ v, exu.HT(), (H.rotation, H.translation) and H = H.Inverse().
